newsitem.title: USA: TWA matches American fare sale.
newsitem.headline: TWA matches American fare sale.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said Tuesday it will match AMR Corp's American Airlines' mileage-based Memorial Day weekend fare sale in most markets.

Discount round trip fares range from $88 to $298, depending on the distance. Travel must begin no earlier than 1201 CDT on Saturday, May 24 and return travel must begin no later than midnight on Sunday, May 25.
Tickets are non-refundable and must be purchased at least one day in advance, and TWA said other restrictions apply.

Trips under 500 miles, such as Des Moines to Little Rock, are priced at $88 round trip, while trips ranging from 501 to 1000 miles, like Boston to Milwaukee, are priced at $138. Trips 1001 to 1500 miles are $178, 1501 to 2000 are $198 and over 2000 are $298.
